verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe Tax determining rates server-side from product type and location, but nothing documents how rate or rule changes are maintained. No item mentions automatic rate updates, change logs, effective-date documentation or a no-redeploy guarantee. Hosted calculation alone only implies vendor maintenance; it does not show that this story's capability is documented.

support.subject: As an ops user, rate and rule changes across thousands of jurisdictions are the vendor's job — updates land automatically, are documented when they take effect, and never require me to redeploy
